description: "Download selected models" loaded every model (transformers.js reads each file fully into JS, copies it into Cache Storage, ORT copies into the WASM heap and GPU). A Gemma summary model peaks at several times its size and WebKitGTK in the Even Hub simulator kills the process (19.5 GB > 16 GB threshold). Stream verified files straight into the adapter's cache instead; load only when a recording or benchmark needs the model. Also: isDownloaded checks the exact files each target needs via cache.keys(), not a load registry.
title: Download models without loading them
